title: The ₹5 Lakh Nobody Told You About

lines.text: A family in Karnataka asks a contractor one simple question: how much will our house cost?
lines.spoken: A family in Karnataka asks a contractor one simple question: how much will our house cost?

lines.text: He says ₹25 lakh.
lines.spoken: He says twenty-five lakh rupees.

lines.text: Eighteen months later, they've spent about ₹30 lakh.
lines.spoken: Eighteen months later, they've spent about thirty lakh.
lines.hero: red LEAK METER starts to roll

lines.text: Here's the strange part. Nobody lied to them. Nobody ran away with the money.
lines.spoken: Here's the strange part. Nobody lied to them. Nobody ran away with the money.
lines.hero: the house again, stamp NOBODY LIED

lines.text: So where did ₹5 lakh go?
lines.spoken: So where did five lakh rupees go?

lines.text: Today we're going to find every rupee. There are seven leaks.
lines.spoken: Today we're going to find every rupee. There are seven leaks.
lines.hero: seven leak markers along the board

lines.text: And leak number seven isn't made of cement or steel. It's made of paper, and it can stop your bank loan cold.
lines.spoken: And leak number seven isn't made of cement or steel. It's made of paper, and it can stop your bank loan cold.

lines.text: Stay till the end, because we'll give you the six questions that plug every one of them.
lines.spoken: Stay till the end, because we'll give you the six questions that plug every one of them.
lines.typed: THE ₹5 LAKH NOBODY TOLD YOU ABOUT

lines.text: Every house quote in India starts with one formula.
lines.spoken: Every house quote in India starts with one formula.

lines.text: Built-up area, times a rate per square foot.
lines.spoken: Built-up area, times a rate per square foot.

lines.text: 1,000 sq ft, at ₹2,500 a square foot. ₹25 lakh.
lines.spoken: A thousand square feet, at two thousand five hundred rupees a square foot. Twenty-five lakh.

lines.text: Basic homes are often quoted around ₹1,800 to ₹2,300 a square foot.
lines.spoken: Basic homes are often quoted around eighteen hundred to twenty-three hundred a square foot.

lines.text: Standard, up to about ₹2,900. Premium, above that.
lines.spoken: Standard, up to about twenty-nine hundred. Premium, above that.
lines.hero: rate cards STANDARD, PREMIUM; indicative, Oct 2026

lines.text: That number feels like the price of your house.
lines.spoken: That number feels like the price of your house.

lines.text: It isn't. It's the price of what's inside the contractor's rate. And a lot of your house lives outside it.
lines.spoken: It isn't. It's the price of what's inside the contractor's rate. And a lot of your house lives outside it.
lines.hero: a box drawn round the diagram; stamp OUTSIDE THE RATE

lines.text: Leak one is hiding in the word area.
lines.spoken: Leak one is hiding in the word area.

lines.text: Contractors usually quote on built-up area: every floor, including the walls, the balcony and the staircase.
lines.spoken: Contractors usually quote on built-up area: every floor, including the walls, the balcony and the staircase.

lines.text: But you live in carpet area, the floor you can actually walk on. And it's always smaller.
lines.spoken: But you live in carpet area, the floor you can actually walk on. And it's always smaller.

lines.text: So when two quotes say the same rate, ask: rate on which area? Get the answer in writing.
lines.spoken: So when two quotes say the same rate, ask: rate on which area? Get the answer in writing.

lines.text: It sounds small. On a full house, it changes the total by lakhs.
lines.spoken: It sounds small. On a full house, it changes the total by lakhs.
lines.hero: pen mark on the wall thickness

lines.text: Leak two is the biggest, and it's a list.
lines.spoken: Leak two is the biggest, and it's a list.
lines.hero: chapter card LEAK 2 · THE LIST; paper checklist

lines.text: Plan approval fees. Before anyone digs, the plan has to be sanctioned, and that costs money.
lines.spoken: Plan approval fees. Before anyone digs, the plan has to be sanctioned, and that costs money.

lines.text: Soil test and structural design. Someone has to check the ground, and design what stands on it.
lines.spoken: Soil test and structural design. Someone has to check the ground, and design what stands on it.

lines.text: Compound wall and gate. Borewell, sump and overhead tank.
lines.spoken: Compound wall and gate. Borewell, sump and overhead tank.

lines.text: Every plot needs them. But none of them are rooms, so none of them fit in a rate per square foot.
lines.spoken: Every plot needs them. But none of them are rooms, so none of them fit in a rate per square foot.
lines.hero: pen bracket on the three items

lines.text: Electricity and water connections.
lines.spoken: Electricity and water connections.

lines.text: You can't live in a house without them. They still sit outside the rate.
lines.spoken: You can't live in a house without them. They still sit outside the rate.

lines.text: Interiors: the modular kitchen, the wardrobes. The things that make it feel like home.
lines.spoken: Interiors: the modular kitchen, the wardrobes. The things that make it feel like home.

lines.text: And GST, if it wasn't already in the quote.
lines.spoken: And GST, if it wasn't already in the quote.

lines.text: None of these are tricks. They're just not inside the per-square-foot rate.
lines.spoken: None of these are tricks. They're just not inside the per-square-foot rate.

lines.text: And most quotes simply don't mention them, so nobody counts them until the bills arrive.
lines.spoken: And most quotes simply don't mention them, so nobody counts them until the bills arrive.

lines.text: In our example, they add up to about ₹3 lakh.
lines.spoken: In our example, they add up to about three lakh.

lines.text: Three lakh that was never in the quote.
lines.spoken: Three lakh that was never in the quote.

lines.text: And then there's the money every builder needs and almost nobody budgets: a contingency.
lines.spoken: And then there's the money every builder needs and almost nobody budgets: a contingency.

lines.text: Usually 5 to 10 percent, for price rises and the changes you'll make along the way.
lines.spoken: Usually five to ten percent, for price rises and the changes you'll make along the way.

lines.text: Because you will make changes. A bigger window here. Better tiles there.
lines.spoken: Because you will make changes. A bigger window here. Better tiles there.

lines.text: At 8 percent, that's another ₹2,24,000.
lines.spoken: At eight percent, that's another two lakh twenty-four thousand.

lines.text: ₹25 lakh just became ₹30 lakh.
lines.spoken: Twenty-five lakh just became thirty.

lines.text: Now the leaks that can push you past thirty.
lines.spoken: Now the leaks that can push you past thirty.

lines.text: Leak three is the soil.
lines.spoken: Leak three is the soil.

lines.text: Across north Karnataka, a lot of land sits on black cotton soil. It swells when it's wet and shrinks when it's dry.
lines.spoken: Across north Karnataka, a lot of land sits on black cotton soil. It swells when it's wet and shrinks when it's dry.

lines.text: Build on it like normal ground, and you get cracks. Build on it properly, and the foundation costs more.
lines.spoken: Build on it like normal ground, and you get cracks. Build on it properly, and the foundation costs more.

lines.text: That's why a soil test isn't paperwork. It's the cheapest insurance in the whole project.
lines.spoken: That's why a soil test isn't paperwork. It's the cheapest insurance in the whole project.

lines.text: Leak four happens quietly, at the material yard.
lines.spoken: Leak four happens quietly, at the material yard.
lines.hero: chapter card LEAK 4 · THE BAG AND THE BAR

lines.text: Nobody hides anything. The quote is just vague.
lines.spoken: Nobody hides anything. The quote is just vague.

lines.text: Your quote says cement. But which cement? 33, 43 or 53 grade? OPC or PPC?
lines.spoken: Your quote says cement. But which cement? Thirty-three, forty-three or fifty-three grade? O P C or P P C?

lines.text: PPC is usually a little cheaper per bag, and both are fine when used right.
lines.spoken: P P C is usually a little cheaper per bag, and both are fine when used right.

lines.text: Your quote says steel. But which TMT? Fe 500 or 500D? Which brand?
lines.spoken: Your quote says steel. But which T M T? F E five hundred, or five hundred D? Which brand?

lines.text: Each choice changes the price. And a quote that just says cement and steel doesn't tell you which one you're getting.
lines.spoken: Each choice changes the price. And a quote that just says cement and steel doesn't tell you which one you're getting.

lines.text: And it doesn't stop at cement and steel. Tiles, paint, wires and pipes all come in cheap and costly versions.
lines.spoken: And it doesn't stop at cement and steel. Tiles, paint, wires and pipes all come in cheap and costly versions.

lines.text: Once they're inside a wall or under a floor, they look the same. Until one of them fails.
lines.spoken: Once they're inside a wall or under a floor, they look the same. Until one of them fails.

lines.text: If the quote doesn't name the brand and grade, two contractors can quote the same price for two very different houses.
lines.spoken: If the quote doesn't name the brand and grade, two contractors can quote the same price for two very different houses.
lines.hero: two quote cards side by side; highlighter on BRAND: ___

lines.text: Same rate on paper. Not the same house.
lines.spoken: Same rate on paper. Not the same house.

lines.text: So ask for an itemised quote: brand and grade of cement, steel, tiles, paint, wiring and plumbing.
lines.spoken: So ask for an itemised quote: brand and grade of cement, steel, tiles, paint, wiring and plumbing.

lines.text: Line by line, so every number has a name next to it.
lines.spoken: Line by line, so every number has a name next to it.

lines.text: Now you're comparing the same house.
lines.spoken: Now you're comparing the same house.

lines.text: Leak five is the most painful, because you pay for it twice.
lines.spoken: Leak five is the most painful, because you pay for it twice.

lines.text: When concrete isn't vibrated properly, it leaves gaps and pockets. Engineers call it honeycombing.
lines.spoken: When concrete isn't vibrated properly, it leaves gaps and pockets. Engineers call it honeycombing.

lines.text: And concrete that dries too fast never reaches its full strength.
lines.spoken: And concrete that dries too fast never reaches its full strength.

lines.text: That's why it has to be cured, kept wet, for days.
lines.spoken: That's why it has to be cured, kept wet, for days.

lines.text: India's concrete code asks for at least 7 days with ordinary cement, and 10 with blended cements like PPC.
lines.spoken: India's concrete code asks for at least seven days with ordinary cement, and ten with blended cements like P P C.

lines.text: Skip it, and the repair bill arrives later. With interest.
lines.spoken: Skip it, and the repair bill arrives later. With interest.

lines.text: Leak six shows up a year after you move in.
lines.spoken: Leak six shows up a year after you move in.
lines.hero: chapter card LEAK 6 · THE WHITE WALL

lines.text: White, powdery patches on the walls. It's called efflorescence: salts carried up by moisture.
lines.spoken: White, powdery patches on the walls. It's called efflorescence: salts carried up by moisture.

lines.text: A thin damp-proof course at plinth level helps stop that moisture.
lines.spoken: A thin damp-proof course at plinth level helps stop that moisture.
lines.hero: DPC diagram; pen arrow on DPC layer

lines.text: Leave it out, and you'll be repainting the same wall again and again.
lines.spoken: Leave it out, and you'll be repainting the same wall again and again.

lines.text: And now, leak seven. The one made of paper.
lines.spoken: And now, leak seven. The one made of paper.

lines.text: In Karnataka, the khata says your property is on the books.
lines.spoken: In Karnataka, the khata says your property is on the books.

lines.text: An A-khata is what banks are most comfortable lending against. B-khata properties can run into trouble with loans and approvals.
lines.spoken: An A-khata is what banks are most comfortable lending against. B-khata properties can run into trouble with loans and approvals.

lines.text: In Bengaluru, an e-khata is now needed to register a property.
lines.spoken: In Bengaluru, an e-khata is now needed to register a property.

lines.text: Then comes the sanctioned plan. And at the end, the occupancy certificate.
lines.spoken: Then comes the sanctioned plan. And at the end, the occupancy certificate.
lines.hero: plan sanction photo, then OC photo

lines.text: Many cities ask for it before they give you permanent connections.
lines.spoken: Many cities ask for it before they give you permanent connections.

lines.text: Get the paper wrong, and the cheapest house in the world can become the one you can't finance.
lines.spoken: Get the paper wrong, and the cheapest house in the world can become the one you can't finance.

lines.text: Can't sell. And can't finish.
lines.spoken: Can't sell. And can't finish.

lines.text: So here are the six questions that plug every leak.
lines.spoken: So here are the six questions that plug every leak.

lines.text: One: rate on built-up or carpet area?
lines.spoken: One: rate on built-up or carpet area?

lines.text: Two: what's not included in this rate?
lines.spoken: Two: what's not included in this rate?

lines.text: Three: has the soil been tested?
lines.spoken: Three: has the soil been tested?

lines.text: Four: which brand and grade of every material?
lines.spoken: Four: which brand and grade of every material?

lines.text: Five: who checks the concrete and the curing?
lines.spoken: Five: who checks the concrete and the curing?

lines.text: Six: are the khata and the plan sanction clear?
lines.spoken: Six: are the khata and the plan sanction clear?

lines.text: Ask these before you sign, and ₹25 lakh stays closer to ₹25 lakh.
lines.spoken: Ask these before you sign, and twenty-five lakh stays closer to twenty-five lakh.
lines.hero: pull back over the whole board

lines.text: Prices, calculators and checklists for your district are on buynbuild.blog.
lines.spoken: Prices, calculators and checklists for your district are on buy n build dot blog.

fact_notes: All rates and the worked example (1,000 sq ft x ₹2,500 = ₹25 L; extras ₹3 L; 8% contingency on ₹28 L = ₹2.24 L; total ₹30.24 L) come from the buynbuild.blog house cost calculator post. Shown on screen as indicative, Oct 2026.
Extras list (approvals, soil test and design, compound wall, borewell/sump/tank, connections, interiors, GST) from the same post.
PPC usually slightly cheaper than OPC: buynbuild.blog PPC cement post. Itemised quote with brand and grade: cost calculator post.
Curing minimum 7 days OPC, 10 days blended (IS 456:2000 cl. 13.5.1). Approved by the user.
e-khata needed for registration in Bengaluru; banks prefer A-khata; OC before permanent connections in many cities. Approved by the user with this cautious wording.
Lines added for the 7-minute cut (Leak 2 and Leak 4) explain the approved items; they add no new numbers or claims.
The family is an illustrative example built from the blog's worked example, labelled ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE on screen.
